##### Project general facts

Parkgreen Residences by Alishaan is a contemporary residential building that celebrates thoughtful design and nature-inspired living. Clean architectural lines are combined with integrated greenery, verdant terrace gardens and a tree-lined rooftop, creating a calm and balanced appearance. The building rises from a ground floor to nine residential floors and offers one-, two- and three-bedroom homes, including two-bedroom apartments with a maid's room, designed for families and professionals seeking comfort and wellbeing.

Amenities support a balanced everyday routine. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool, a fully equipped gym and a fitness studio, together with a yoga area and a co-working space for focused work. A multipurpose room and a games lounge with billiards offer places to gather, while an indoor kids' play area keeps the youngest residents entertained. Landscaped communal spaces, park access, relaxation areas and a welcoming lobby inspired by Persian aesthetics complete the shared facilities.

Interiors feature light-filled layouts, natural textures and refined finishes designed for everyday comfort. The lobby combines rich wood finishes, calming lighting and nature-inspired textures, setting the tone for homes where life unfolds naturally. Living and dining areas open onto balconies and terraces, and bedrooms offer quiet, private retreats. Residences are delivered semi-furnished with a fully equipped kitchen including home appliances, leaving furniture and decoration to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Liwan is a residential neighbourhood within Dubailand, located between Dubai Silicon Oasis, Nad Al Sheba and Academic City. The area combines low-rise apartment buildings, community retail and green spaces with easy access to the city's major highways, offering a calm, family-friendly setting close to healthcare facilities such as King's College Hospital London Dubai, as well as schools, nurseries and supermarkets.

Silicon Central Mall, GEMS FirstPoint School and Dubai Outlet Mall are a short drive away, as are Zayed University and Academic City. Dubai Hills Mall, Global Village, Downtown Dubai, The Dubai Mall, Business Bay, Dubai Design District and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable driving distance via Al Ain Road, Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, while public transport links add further convenience.

Liwan is a freehold area that attracts young professionals, families and investors seeking accessible entry points within reach of Dubai's main business districts. Steady demand from tenants working in Dubai Silicon Oasis and the surrounding hubs supports attractive rental yields. Continued development across Dubailand strengthens the long-term appeal of the area for owners and investors focused on rental income and capital growth.
